description: Start a draft or paused poll on its schedule. Each run spends the account's balance, so the request must carry max_cost_usd, the most it may commit (estimate_poll gives the figure, and a refusal says the exact amount). Refused with 402 if the balance cannot cover it and 409 if this key's monthly allowance cannot; nothing is spent by a refusal. Confirm the cost with the account holder first. (POST /api/v1/polls/{id}/start)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

max_cost_usd.description: The most, in US dollars, you agree this may commit. Required: the call is refused with the amount it needs if this is missing or too low.

name: start_poll
title: Start a poll
